cues.en: Welcome to the first content section of this course.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到課程第一個正式內容章節。

cues.en: I hope you are excited to begin.
cues.zh: 希望你迫不及待想開始。

cues.en: I created these short summary and goals videos at the start of each section to give you a few general comments that I'd like you to keep in mind as you're working through this section.
cues.zh: 每節開頭都有這種簡短的摘要與目標影片，提供一些整體建議，讓你學習本節時放在心上。

cues.en: Now, I'm not going to read a list of things that you'll learn in this section because that's basically just the titles of the videos.
cues.zh: 我不會逐項念這節要學什麼，因為基本上就是影片標題。

cues.en: Instead, what I want to say is what I consider to be the most important theme in this section.
cues.zh: 相反地，我想談本節最重要的主題。

cues.en: This is the thread that ties together all of the videos in this section, and here for this section.
cues.zh: 這是串起本節全部影片的主線；在這一節，

cues.en: That theme is to understand the characteristics of a function simply by looking at the equation of that function.
cues.zh: 主題是只看函數方程式，就能理解函數特性。

cues.en: And by characteristics.
cues.zh: 這裡所說的特性，

cues.en: Here I mean the behavior of the function.
cues.zh: 是指函數的行為。

cues.en: What does it look like visually?
cues.zh: 視覺上長什麼樣子？

cues.en: What happens to the function as it gets close to zero and as you approach infinity on both sides?
cues.zh: 接近零，以及往兩側無窮遠靠近時，函數會如何變化？

cues.en: For example, if I show you a function, an equation that looks like this, you should immediately be
cues.zh: 例如我給你看這樣的函數方程式，你應該立刻，

cues.en: able to see that the graph of this function passes through three when x equals zero and it has this
cues.zh: 看出圖形在 x 等於零時通過三，而且有這種，

cues.en: general kind of shape and it's a third order polynomial and it's continuous and it has both a domain and range comprising all real numbers and so on.
cues.zh: 大致形狀，是三次多項式、連續，定義域和值域都包含所有實數等等。

cues.en: There is a lot of information about a function that you can extract simply by looking at the equation, just by looking at the formula.
cues.zh: 只看方程式、只看公式，就能擷取很多函數資訊。

cues.en: And building that skill is the main goal of this section.
cues.zh: 培養這個能力，是本節主要目標。

cues.en: Now what does this function even mean?
cues.zh: 但這個函數到底代表什麼？

cues.en: Does it correspond to something in nature?
cues.zh: 對應自然界的什麼東西嗎？

cues.en: Does it describe some financial system or like a video game component?
cues.zh: 描述金融系統，或遊戲元件嗎？

cues.en: None of those things.
cues.zh: 都不是。

cues.en: It is literally just a bunch of random terms that I tossed together in this slide.
cues.zh: 只是我在投影片上，隨便拼湊的一堆項。

cues.en: I just made it up.
cues.zh: 是我編出來的。

cues.en: It has no actual real world meaning, so why bother?
cues.zh: 沒有真實世界的意義，那何必研究？

cues.en: Why bother studying equations like this?
cues.zh: 為什麼要研究這種方程式？

cues.en: You could say, you know, you could ask the question, why should I work with weird functions?
cues.zh: 你可能會問，為什麼要處理奇怪的函數？

cues.en: And by weird I'm referring to just some random made up mathematical expressions that have nothing to
cues.zh: 所謂奇怪，是指隨機編出的數學運算式，和，

cues.en: do with biology or data science or deep learning algorithms or any other application you might be interested in.
cues.zh: 生物學、資料科學、深度學習演算法，或你感興趣的其他應用無關。

cues.en: In fact, a lot of setting math involves working with equations that have no real world application except for practicing for an exam.
cues.zh: 其實學數學有很多時候，都在處理除了準備考試之外，沒有實際應用的方程式。

cues.en: And the exam is also made up of equations without any real world application.
cues.zh: 而考試也都是沒有實際應用的方程式。

cues.en: Well, the answer is that you want to work with a lot of arbitrary collections of mathematical functions because that's how you build foundational knowledge upon which everything else is built.
cues.zh: 答案是，你需要操作各式各樣任意組合的數學函數，因為這能建立所有後續內容的基礎知識。

cues.en: So the more equations and the more variety of equations that you work with, the easier it will be to understand the equations that you really do care about.
cues.zh: 處理的方程式越多、種類越多，就越容易理解真正關心的方程式。

cues.en: For example, if you're trying to understand a mathematical model of a wind turbine or some fancy new
cues.zh: 例如想理解風力發電機的數學模型，或某種新奇的，

cues.en: algorithm for nonlinear pattern classification or millions of other applications, you know, I like to think of the gym as an analogy.
cues.zh: 非線性模式分類演算法，或其他數百萬種應用。我喜歡用健身房比喻。

cues.en: You go to the gym to increase your fitness, to build muscle, boost your cardio capacity and so on.
cues.zh: 去健身房是為了增強體能、鍛鍊肌肉、提升心肺功能等等。

cues.en: But the things that you do at the gym are super weird, right?
cues.zh: 但健身房裡的動作其實很奇怪，對吧？

cues.en: I mean, when in your life do you need to lift a thin, long metal pole with circular weights at both ends of it?
cues.zh: 生活中什麼時候需要舉起一根細長金屬桿，兩端還掛圓形重物？

cues.en: It's hilarious and bizarre when you think about it, but that's not the point.
cues.zh: 想一想，真的很好笑又奇怪，但重點不在這裡。

cues.en: The point is that doing these kinds of exercises in the gym help you do everything else that you want to do in your day to day life.
cues.zh: 重點是，健身房做這些練習，能幫你完成日常生活其他想做的事。

cues.en: Well, it's the same thing with mathematics.
cues.zh: 數學也一樣。

cues.en: You work with random weird looking functions in order to build the foundational knowledge and experience.
cues.zh: 操作隨機又奇怪的函數，是為了建立基礎知識與經驗。

cues.en: And then outside the course, you use that foundational knowledge to help you understand, implement and develop applications in applied math that really do have meaningful equations.
cues.zh: 然後在課程之外，用這些基礎知識，理解、實作並開發有實際意義方程式的應用數學。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Anyway, that's it for this video.
cues.zh: 總之，這支影片就到這裡。

cues.en: Again, there's a lot of specific things that you will learn about in this section of the course, But the most important goal and what I want you to think about as you're going through these videos and
cues.zh: 再說一次，本節會學很多具體內容，但最重要的目標，也是希望你在看影片、

cues.en: the code and the exercises is developing the skill of looking at a mathematical expression and understanding
cues.zh: 程式和做練習時思考的，是培養看著數學運算式，就理解，

cues.en: its characteristics and its behavior purely from the equations.
cues.zh: 其特性與行為的能力，完全從方程式判讀。

cues.en: Well, I hope you're excited to learn.
cues.zh: 希望你期待接下來的學習。

cues.en: So let's go to the next video and begin.
cues.zh: 我們到下一支影片開始。
